label: cal1
what: calibration: v1, server on 4 cores (CPUs 0-3), 20k users ts 0.25 + 50k idle

label: v1-1c-r1
what: v1 first correct version: io_uring thread per core, 64r+32w PG, libdeflate L1

label: prof-v1
what: perf profile of v1 (1 core): kernel 68%, libdeflate ~17.5% (deflate_compress_fastest 11.6, flush_block 2.4, make_huffman_code 1.6, sort_symbols 1.2), managed code small; conntrack (docker on the box) 1.4%

label: e1
what: wait for 128 completions or 2 ms after a busy pass (#30), WAIT_N=128 WAIT_US=2000, same build

label: e2
what: gzip with ISA-L igzip level 0 (isal_deflate_stateless) instead of libdeflate level 1, via native/gz.c
why: per request (perf stat, 90 s, x3): user kinstr 88.9 -> 46.0, total kinstr 148.8 -> 107.1, total kcycles 151.0 -> 128.7 (median); igzip L1 122.8 kinstr / 131.6 kcycles. Feed body 2243 B vs 1901 B gzipped (both 2 TCP segments). 42/42

label: mem-v1
what: idle connection hold, 4 threads, holder on the same box (slab covers both ends)
note: ~8.4 KB kernel slab per connection pair (~4.2 KB/socket); app RSS flat past 150k; health 200 after 400k

label: env
what: box: docker, docker.socket and containerd stopped, nft ruleset flushed (iptables-nft NAT rules kept conntrack on every loopback packet; the grader's app box has none). Saved in /opt/muc/nft-before.txt. Base kernel kinstr/req 61.1 -> 53.9

label: e3
what: igzip L0 with Huffman tables retrained from a live body at most once a second (GZIP_TRAIN=1)
why: CPU neutral: total kinstr 100.0 vs 100.0, kcycles 119.7/121.6/116.3 vs 120.7/118.1/117.0; feed 1961 B vs 2243 B (-12.6% bytes). Option stays, default off

label: e4
what: retest of e1 with perf counts: after a busy pass wait for N completions or T (WAIT_N/WAIT_US) 32/1ms and 128/2ms vs none
why: w32: kinstr 100.0 -> 90.8 (-9%), kcycles median 118.1 -> 100.6 (-15%), passes/req 1.96 -> 0.13, p95 1.4-1.8 -> 3.5-3.6 ms; w128 same CPU (90.0, 101.4) but p95 8.4 ms. /proc/stat time shows no gain for w32 (53 vs 52-55 us, tick-sampled), app cgroup 45-46 -> 40-44. Postgres us/req up 147-157 -> 189-217 (bursts spread over 64 conns)

label: overload-e2
what: overload.sh: 30k connect+close (half RST), 20k half requests, 20k unread gzip feeds (half RST), 2000 x 64 pipelined feeds to tiny-rcvbuf slow readers; then same pid, health 200, gzip feed, post 201

label: e4-hot
what: e4 confirm at ~13.8-15.2k req/s on 1 core (36k users ts 0.25): WAIT 32/1ms (new default) vs WAIT_N=1

label: e5
what: no gzip (GZIP_MIN=1e9) vs igzip L0, e2 build (1 core, 20k users) and e4 build hot (36k users)
why: CPU: kinstr 100.3 -> 83.2 (-17%), kcycles median 118.4 -> 111.5 (-6%); hot (vs w32): kinstr 89.8 -> 72.9, kcycles 96.7/94.6 -> 86.0/90.8 (-8%). But SPEC: 'the load is measured with compressed responses in mind'; grader NIC speed unknown (Synteq VPS); uncompressed feed ~5.3 KB vs ~2.4 KB with headers, at 1.2M users ~0.95 Gbps outbound uncompressed. Kept gzip until the NIC is known

label: prof-e2
what: perf profile, e2 build, clean box, 1 core
result: kernel 75% and flat (loopback peer receive work: tcp_v4_rcv, ep_poll_callback for mload/Postgres sockets lands on CPU 0 here, not on the grader); igzip ~2.7%; managed code < 1% per symbol
